reviewedControls: Frozen source and sealed artifact verified unchanged.
Exactly98 current critical path/hash pairs must equal the independent drift scan, and the reviewed Playwright driver is rehashed.

Every current production-input delta must equal the four independently reviewed accounting changes. Only the three named concurrent close documentation areas and tests are separately classified; unrelated control files are not silently exempted.
Original source-admission failure remains intact; source-admission-frozen.json and final-integrity-frozen.json are separate exclusive receipts.
Runtime explicitly requires frozen_artifact_only scope and currentCheckoutQualified:false and reports that limitation.
All prior real-session, browser-cache, provider, privacy, native-effect and owned cleanup controls remain unchanged.
conditions: Run the already sealed artifact unchanged; do not merge concurrent source or rebuild implicitly.
Preserve all concurrent source/tests/docs and the failed whole-root comparison.
The source admission must explicitly state frozen-artifact-only scope and currentCheckoutQualified:false; final evidence must retain that distinction.
A current whole-checkout build, accounting-close validation or production release cannot be inferred from this run.
Any newly changed admitted guard/consumer, executed changed function branch, or unsafe target requires stopping and refreshing the affected scope.
At completion recheck frozen candidate/artifact integrity and admitted critical inputs; report current root drift separately rather than calling the checkout unchanged.
